title: On the weighted weak-type constant for the dyadic square function
summary: We present an explicit construction of examples showing that the estimate $ \|S(f)\|_{L^2(w)\to L^{2,\infty}(w)}\lesssim \big([w]_{A_2} \log(1 + [w]_{A_2})\big)^{1/2}$ for the dyadic square function is sharp in terms of the characteristic $[w]_{A_2}$.
